compile_validation.source: Pinned upstream Wine 11.20 plus this patch series
compile_validation.configuration: Isolated module build using an available compiler and extracted development headers; optional unrelated Wine features were omitted.

limits: This is not a complete modern WoW64/i386 build.
A complete Wine/gamescope runtime and application integration from the public recipe have not been validated.
No application benchmark or production suitability claim is made.
record_scope: The original source_lock_sha256, source_preparation, compile_validation and limits fields are historical pre-v0.2.0 records. Newer patch-specific evidence appears in window_resize_tracking and tooltip_tracking_coordinates; do not apply historical build limits or counts to a different source lock.

source_preparation.line_offset_note: The preexisting GDI+ patch applies with line offsets and exact context; no context fuzz is used. The new move/resize patch needs no offsets.

compile_validation.source: Pinned Wine 11.20 with this six-patch Wine series

synthetic_regressions.scope: Original own-window fixtures in disposable, networkless prefixes. No vendor application, accounts, saved settings or market data used.

coverage: Slow one-pixel and fast 250-pixel pointer motion
Exact preexisting minimum and maximum size bounds

snapping_retention.coverage: All eight resize directions and caption movement; the endpoint remains snapped when the pointer stops inside the magnet range.

supplemental.historical_limit: Child/full-window multikey keyboard trials encountered an existing input-loop exit in both variants. Invalid injections were excluded and replaced by bounded commit/cancel controls; no multikey child/full-window reliability claim is made.

limits: These are input and geometry correctness checks, not application performance benchmarks.
No high-DPI, cross-GPU, production-trading or actual application corner-gesture guarantee is established.
The prebuilt v0.2.0 runtime archive was not rebuilt or replaced for this source change.

tooltip_tracking_coordinates.scope: Local Wine TTM_TRACKPOSITION signed16 x/y extraction only; existing patches and tooltip sizing, clipping, monitor and rendering paths retained.

synthetic_regressions.scope: Original MIT own-tooltip source in fresh networkless prefixes on own Xvfb without a window manager; no vendor resources or physical host actions.
synthetic_regressions.visibility_result: FAIL for sole-Xvfb outside-all-workarea requests; not a valid-negative-monitor host acceptance test
synthetic_regressions.visibility_limit: The original fixture checks exact signed decoding and IsWindowVisible, not positive rectangle extents. Its far-left request lies outside all active Xvfb workareas and can expose retained zero-width clipping. The stronger portable verifier retains these failures and requires actual EnumDisplayMonitors workareas; no full-popup pass is claimed.
synthetic_regressions.host_negative_monitor_acceptance: unverified; separate valid-negative-monitor interior and actual visible-popup checks required

limits: Synthetic coordinate correctness only; no host focus, physical-monitor placement, composed pixels, vendor popup, GPU stability or trading suitability guarantee.
Compiled module evidence covers x86_64 v5/v6, not a newly built complete modern WoW64 runtime.
Published v0.2.0 runtime/source-companion archives were not rebuilt or replaced.

minimized_gdi_preview.default: Original behavior for unset or any other value.
minimized_gdi_preview.scope: Buffered GDI pixel and bounding-shape submission for direct-host managed minimized windows; no window owner, taskbar, close, GPU client-surface or vendor binary changes.

actual_callback_regressions.scope: Actual extracted pinned callback bodies with inert mocks and simplified types; no X11, Wine or application execution.

original_gdi_regressions.scope: Original own-window fixture on disposable networkless Xvfb; no application or host display.
original_gdi_regressions.controls: Baseline and candidate unset/0 alter minimized pixels/shape; restoration matches exactly.
original_gdi_regressions.enabled: Candidate exact1 preserves exact pixels and bounding shape across both minimize/restore cycles, including resize.

limits: Synthetic callback and original GDI results do not establish GNOME taskbar, popup lifecycle, physical input, monitor layout, actual application or GPU stability acceptance.
Preserved minimized preview is a static last normal frame. Deferred dirty-work resource cost requires separate screening.
Existing published prebuilt runtime and source-companion assets were not rebuilt or replaced.
